title: Baked Tofu Patties with Cherry Tomatoes, Cherries and Chilli
subtitle: in a charred tomato and cherry sauce
description: Soft, light tofu patties baked, then simmered in a tomato and fresh cherry sauce and grilled until lightly charred.

steps.text: Crumble the tofu into a bowl. Grate the zucchini and onion, crush 1 clove of garlic, and add them to the tofu with the lentil flour, oats, chopped parsley, 2 tbsp olive oil, soy sauce, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Mix to a soft, even mixture, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper greased with olive oil. With lightly oiled hands, shape the mixture into ping pong ball-sized patties, space them on the tray and bake for about 20 minutes, until lightly golden with a dry crust. Let cool while you make the sauce.

Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a wide, shallow ovenproof pot. Add the sliced green chilli, and the Roma tomatoes cut lengthways into quarters and the whole cherry tomatoes, and cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes.

Add the pitted cherries, 4 sliced garlic cloves, thyme, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper and cook over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tomatoes and cherries start to char and the sauce becomes thick and chunky. Add the water, cook 2 minutes more and turn off the heat.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Arrange the baked patties in the pot and spoon the sauce over them (do not stir, as it may break them up). Bake uncovered for 15 minutes.
Raise the oven to 230°C and switch to grill mode. Grill the patties for about 4 minutes, until nicely browned.
